translation.name: Na Rongorongo Uto nina Jesus Christ

content: Peter te tutughunitate vania na holohoru i Jerusalem
Ma gaira na lei manevetena, mana balu taluutuni ghua tana lei komu Judea tara rongovia didira gaira rana mua Jew tara lavipangotia na bosana God.
Mi tana bona Peter te dato Jerusalem, gaira na balu Jew tara taluutuni tara liona na pahevaughilaladira rana mua Jew, tara koehorua gaia mara ghaghua,
“Ighoe to hughua nina vetena God na pukuna to rughuhaghe tana valedira tara mua Jew mo nira vanga kolu.”
Ma Peter te vuivuni ni tughuni alaala vanira,
“Inau tu kokoeliulivuti tana komu Joppa, mu righia na mabubu. Mu vaevanea te vaghaa na kuikuvi selo sule God te lubati horua mai i kokou tana vati na piuna na parako, me mai sara tagua.
Mu reihaghe lokana mu righia na lei vata ni maumanu, mana na lei vata ni maumanu tara tagutagu tana pari, mana lei manu tana oka.
Mi nau tu rongovia na manga te bosa vaniu, ‘Ko tughuru Peter. Paepahe mo ko vanga!’
“Mi nau tu ghaghua, ‘Taho Lord, Ku mua ghanighi na lei totobo raini na pukuna tara meto tana nilabumami.’
“Eruani na manga, te ghoi bosa vaniu mai so i kokou, ‘Ko bei holo metoni gea na hava God te va marabui tua.’
Me tolu na tughuru ni neana te vaghaa eni, vaho ge ra ghora datoa na kuikuvi selo tana parako.
Me mua hau, e tolu na tinoni tara sara mai tua tana vale tu ghahau iga, tara nira vetena vaniu mai Caesarea.

Mana Tarunga Tabu te mina bosa vaniu ge ku nira udukolu ku bei hove gea, ma raini e ono ghua na hoghogu itagua rana taluutuni ni Joppa tara niu udukolu vaa Caesarea, mi ghai udolu tai vaa rughuhaghe tana valena Cornelius.
Mete bosa vanighai ivei te nea na tate vaniana na angel te tughuru lokani valena mete bosa vania, ‘Ko vetena vaa siki sakai Joppa, me ke hola mai na tinoni na ahana Simon Peter.
Ma gaia ke kokoei vanighau ivei ke nea na vavolaghau God, ighoe ma nimua na binaboli udolu tana vale.’
Mi tana bona inau tu vuivunia na kokokoe, na Tarunga Tabu te horu tua vuvungadira te vaghaa te horu mai vuvungada tana vuivuni.
Mi nau tu ghanaghana olia, na hava Lord te bosa, ‘John te nia vulitabu na beti, mi ghau kau nia vulitabu ghua na Tarunga Tabu.’
Te vaghaa God te hera tua rana mua Jew na sonihalavu ni Tarunga Tabu te vaghaa te vaheghita tana bona ta taluutunia Lord Jesus Christ, ma ahei inau ge ku tughuru pungisia God!”
Tana bona tara rongovia, mara beto didira na kokoe koliliana, mara holoutoa vamua God mara ghaghua, “Itaeni God te vahera na maana vanira rana mua Jew ge kara tughulio ge kara vola.”
Na holohoru i Antioch

Bona tara peta matea tua Stephen, na balu taluutuni tara havukaghi tana lei komu na pukuna na gunaguna, mara vaa sara Antioch mi tana bubulo Phoenicia mi tana koukomu lau Cyprus, mara tughunitatea iga na Rongorongo Uto vanira na Jew vamua.
Hauvaa mana balu tinoni taluutuni Cyprus mi tana komu Cyrene, tara vaa sara ghua Antioch, mara bosa tatea iga na rongorongo vanira rana mua Jew, maia nina Rongorongo Uto Lord Jesus.
Ma nina maana Lord itadira, mana vure subo tara taluutunia mara liliu pulohi vania Lord.
E saravia na rongorongo na holohoru Jerusalem, vaho ge ra nia vetena Barnabas vaa Antioch.
Mi tana saraana vaho, ge vaevanea gaia God te vautora sughua nina vure me nira togo, me kokoe patupatura ge kara vavaravaghi utuni vania Lord, nia na tobadira udolu.
Barnabas na tinoni uto, me vonughia na Tarunga Tabu mana taluutuni, me subo ni tinoni tara mai mara va taluutunia Lord.
Ma Barnabas te tona Tarsus ge ke kenea Saul.
Me topoa tua ge hola vaa Antioch, mana niulu udolu rogaira toro vaukolu tadira na holohoru moro taraira na vure subo. Mi Antioch vaho rana taluutuni tara vuivunia na holoadira nia ‘Christian.’
Mi tana bongi eni, balu prophet tara rughuhoru mai Jerusalem, mara vaa sara Antioch.

Ma sakai itadira na ahana Agabus te tughuru dato ta nina maana na Tarunga Tabu, me bosadila na ngengere sule ke kalea na maramana. Me kale utuni na totobo eni, tana bongina Claudius na vunaghi haba ni Rome.
Ma sasakai tadira rana taluutuni ke nia hevei nina heveioli vanira lei hoghodira rana taluutuni tara kabu i Judea.
Mara nea te vaghaa eni, mara nighi vetena gatu didira heveioli, vanira lei mane kamanagho ni holohoru tana limadira Barnabas maia Saul.

footnotes.text: Christian ra nina Christ. Na ghanaghana ilokana na marena Christ.
